description: The plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden state values across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", also has a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. Three lines are depicted in the plot: the blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate", starting at approximately 0.1 at layer 0 and increasing to around 4.5 at layer 23, with a notable sharp rise from layer 19 onwards; the orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate", remaining relatively stable near 0 across all layers; and the green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline", also staying close to 0 throughout the layers, with both the orange and green lines showing minimal variation.
